title: Effects of lemborexant and zolpidem on sleep electroencephalography in older adults with insomnia: a randomized trial
comparison_or_design: The selected NREM comparison of lemborexant 10 mg and extended-release zolpidem 6.25 mg.
time_scope: Change from acute nights 1–2 to chronic nights 29–30.
excluded: Baseline-referenced contrasts, REM, other bands, LEM5/placebo and omnibus tests over excluded arms
ISI correlations, subgroups and independent EEG reanalysis
population_or_material: The analyzable EEG subgroup of older adults with insomnia in this report, using source-supported PSG/EEG assessment denominators.
requested_items: NREM acute-to-chronic paragraph: numerical within-arm t tests and associated df/P/d for SO/alpha/theta in the selected two arms. Include a direct between-arm acute-to-chronic estimate only if explicitly reported. Exclude duplicate qualitative descriptions, baseline-referenced electrode comparisons and plot digitization.
case_specific_rules: For the selected within-arm NREM acute-to-chronic t tests, use the dedicated one-sample-test paragraph over conflicting general statistical-method wording. Recover its adjustment method from that paragraph and preserve the reported P values.
Retain the source-reported change definitions, transformation and temporal interpretation; do not construct an unprinted composite formula. Apply the shared endpoint-denominator rules.
